state.task: Review how the renewal eligibility rule is represented in the renewal job and account screen.

artifacts.content:
def eligible(account):
    return account.active and account.unpaid_days <= 7

def show_renew_button(account):
    return account.active and account.unpaid_days < 8
There is one renewal eligibility policy for all accounts. The scheduled renewal job and customer screen must make the same decision from the same account data.
